size_rules.interior: x 1..W-2, y 3..H-2 (north wall 3 tiles: cap + 2 face rows; other walls 1 tile)
size_rules.walls: every room is closed on all four sides; the only openings are door sockets
size_rules.hallways: 1x1 cells; corridor 4 tiles wide, arms only toward connected sockets (straight, corner, T, cross, dead end)

sockets.per_cell_side: every cell side on the room perimeter has exactly one socket at its centre
sockets.snap: rooms on neighbouring grid cells always share socket positions, so any two rooms connect

door_states.locked: ice bars + brass plate; opens when the floor elite drops its key
door_states.oneway_in: chevrons point into this room: enter only
door_states.oneway_out: chevrons point out: exit only (shortcut back toward the start)

roles.start: arrival (dock on F1, stairs-up landing below)
roles.treasure: chest + coin pile, door locked until the floor elite drops the key
roles.stairs: stairs down to the next floor

role_props_v2.note: 94-96 (v2). The 77f shop_counter / shrine props and the 78 role rooms stay unchanged; Room2 (rm16_g1.py) places these v2 props for the shop and shrine roles.

props: north row reserved; drawn as an overlay after the room pass with its base 6 px into the counter top, then the counter is re-composited over it
3 stands on row Ih/2+1, spaced 6 tiles (2x1 rooms) / 4 tiles (1x1 rooms)

ui.price_chip: 94e, floats 6 px above the card; states ok/nope/sale/sold
ui.buy_prompt: 94e, above the player when in range (1 tile)

shrine: idle loop (glow ring + motes on fx)
activate (13f: runes light, crystal lifts in telescoping prongs, beam + pick-3 silhouettes) -> spent static
